rapport_notes: Efficient, thorough on a three-stop move, professional and friendly throughout.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before we get started, do you have any questions or concerns beyond the price about the move that you'd like answered on this call today?" (asked before logistics probing)
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer said 'Nope' to the agenda question, nothing to dig into
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "I'll kind of put you on the higher end the four and a half to five and a half hours"; Communication: "they will call you the day before to confirm and then they will also call you the morning to let you know that they are on the way"

top_strength: Delivered the full communication differentiator (day-before call + morning on-the-way call) unprompted at the close — one of the few calls in the batch to land that piece cleanly.
coaching_note: No quid pro quo framing before the agenda question — jumping straight to 'do you have questions' without first setting expectations for the call's length/purpose.
